payload.title: Pin Papyrus 5.15.1
payload.description: Bump the exact pin from 5.13.0 to 5.15.1 in package.json, package-lock.json, infra/package.json (and its lock), infra/site.json and requirements-publication.txt. 5.15.1 is on npm and PyPI and carries the PAPYRUS_SITE_ORIGIN sign-in fix (Papyrus #483). The app-shell CDK deploy that delivers PAPYRUS_SITE_ORIGIN is a separate ticket.
